entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling to see about returning a VeloBand Pulse monitor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure. The name is Jordan Smith, and the order number should be VF-95513.
Thank you, Jordan. I see the order here, delivered on December 16th, which was 44 days ago. To understand the best way to help, is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?

It works perfectly fine. To be honest, I just **changed my mind** about it. It was an **impulse buy** right when it came out, and I find I really **don't use it** at all. I know it's been over a month, so I was wondering if we could maybe work something out, like a partial store credit?
I appreciate the transparency, Jordan. Thank you for clarifying that. Let me just check the official return policy for you. Please hold one moment.
Alright, I've pulled it up. It looks like our policy allows for returns on items within 10 days of delivery, as long as they're in the original condition.
Oh, really? Ninety days? I was all prepared for a negotiation.
Yes, sir. And since you're at day 44, you're well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund right now. No problem at all.
Wow, that's fantastic. That's much easier than I expected. Thank you!

You're very welcome. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll get an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
Perfect. Sounds great. I appreciate your help, Charlie.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
